verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's docs describe adding/updating documents to an index and instant search, implying near-real-time indexing, and some users report blazing-fast indexing (meilisearch-comm-10, meilisearch-comm-6). However, hands-on production reports concretely contradict this for high-churn workloads: one team says 'indexing performance for constantly changing records wasn't great and Meilisearch would fall behind on indexing for hours' (meilisearch-comm-4), and others report unpredictable resource usage and write-scaling issues under heavy load (meilisearch-comm-3, meilisearch-comm-13). missing for 10: explicit vendor documentation of update latency/consistency guarantees, and resolution of the conflicting production reports on indexing lag under heavy write traffic.
